definition.name: Focused managed Task runtime with authenticated native products

steps.name: Check managed task authority and retirement controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_task_runtime tools.tests.test_dotnet_task_wait -v

steps.name: Retrieve only exact source-bound native products and companion packages
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin e97d44ddc744c9bd738d9b3b7a7d8b7234133e36
python3 tools/replay_dotnet_tasks.py --prepare --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/task-prepared"

steps.name: Install captured NativeAOT namespace and loader inputs
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the pinned native compiler and closed runtime
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Build one fresh NativeAOT component, sign and execute ordinary managed Tasks
Retain bounded source, compiler, component and node evidence

with.name: dotnet-tasks-focused-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/task-prepared/retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/task-prepared/selected-host/host-retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/qualified.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/replay-materials.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/outside/evidence/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/node/public-workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/node/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-task-runtime/node/controls/dotnet-ordinary-tasks-*.json

reviewReason: Explicit default-false diagnostic Task replay selects only its bounded job. Normal PR/push/ordinary dispatch keeps every old toolchain command and original per-step guard, budget and prerequisite.
